product.name: HP BN03XL Battery
product.full_name: Replacement Battery for HP ENVY 13-ba & ENVY x360 13/15 Series
product.description: Replacement battery (Model BN03XL, Part No. L76965-AC1, Regulatory Model HSTNN-OB1O) for HP ENVY 13-ba series, ENVY x360 13-ay series, ENVY x360 13-bd series, ENVY x360 15-ed series, ENVY x360 15-ee series, ENVY x360 15-es series, ENVY x360 15-eu series, and selected 15-ew configurations. Also cross-compatible with L76965-2C1, L76965-271, L77034-005, L73965-271, L76985-271 and HSTNN-DB9N. 3-cell, 51Wh, 11.55V Li-Polymer, rated 4195mAh. Tested before dispatch, drop-in fit — no disassembly beyond the standard battery bay.

delivery_note: Same-day delivery in Nairobi · 1–2 days upcountry

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on this battery?
faqs.answer: Yes — this battery carries a 6-month warranty from the date of purchase.

faqs.question: How do I install it?
faqs.answer: It's a standard drop-in replacement — no disassembly beyond the battery bay. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if needed.

faqs.question: Can I pay via M-Pesa?
faqs.answer: Yes, M-Pesa is accepted, along with cash on delivery in select areas.
